verses.uthmani: الٓمٓ
verses.indopak: الٓمّٓ ۗ
verses.transliteration: ﻿alifl<u>a</u>mmeem
verses.saheeh: Alif, Lam, Meem.
verses.khattab: Alif-Lãm-Mĩm
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Alif lām mīm: God knows best what He means by these [letters].
verses.romanUrdu: Alif Laam Meem

verses.uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: تَنْزِيْلُ الْكِتٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: tanzeelu alkitabi la rayba feehi min rabbi al'alameena
verses.saheeh: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: The revelation of this Book is—beyond doubt—from the Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The revelation of the Book, the Qur'an (tanzīlu’l-kitābi, the subject) whereof there is no doubt (lā rayba fīh, the first predicate) from the Lord of the Worlds (min rabbi’l-‘ālamīna, the second predicate).
verses.romanUrdu: Is kitaab ki tanzil (nuzul/revelation) bila shubha Rubb ul aalameen ki taraf se hai

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ ٱفۡتَرَىٰهُ ۚ بَلۡ هُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمٗا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَهۡتَدُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰٮهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّاۤ اَتٰٮهُمْ مِّنْ نَّذِيْرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: am yaqooloona iftarahu bal huwa alhaqqu min rabbika litunthira qawman ma atahum min natheerin min qablika la'allahum yahtadoona
verses.saheeh: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muhammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.
verses.khattab: Or do they say, “He has fabricated it!”? No! It is the truth from your Lord in order for you to warn a people to whom no warner has come before you, so they may be ˹rightly˺ guided
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or do they say, ‘He, Muhammad (s), has invented it’? Nay, but it is the truth from your Lord, that you may warn, thereby, a people to whom no warner came before you (mā is for negation) that perhaps they may find [right] guidance, by your warning.
verses.romanUrdu: Kya yeh log kehte hain ke is shaks ne isey khud ghadh liya hai? Nahin, balke yeh haqq hai tere Rubb ki taraf se taa-ke tu mutanabbeh (warn) karey ek aisi qaum ko jiske paas tujhse pehle koi mutanabbeh (warn) karne nahin aaya. Shayad ke woh hidayat paa jayein

verses.uthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٖ ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.indopak: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِىْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِىْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ ۗ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ وَّلِىٍّ وَّلَا شَفِيْعٍ ۗ اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa 'ala al'arshi ma lakum min doonihi min waliyyin wala shafee'in afala tatathakkaroona
verses.saheeh: It is Allah who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?
verses.khattab: It is Allah Who has created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. You have no protector or intercessor besides Him. Will you not then be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God is He Who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days, the first of which was Sunday and the last of which was Friday, then He presided upon the Throne (al-‘arsh in the [classical Arabic] idiom denotes the seat of a king), a presiding worthy of Him. You do not have, O disbelievers of Mecca, besides Him, in other words, other than Him, any protector (min waliyyin is the subject of the particle mā with the min added [extra]) in other words, [any] helper, or intercessor, to ward off His chastisement from you. Will you not then remember?, this and become believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh Allah hi hai jisne aasmaano aur zameen ko aur un saari cheezon ko jo inke darmiyan hain chey (six) dino mein paida kiya aur iske baad arsh par jalwa farma hua. Uske siwa na tumhara koi haami o madadgar hai aur na koi uske aagey sifarish karne wala. Phir kya tum hosh mein na aaogey

verses.uthmani: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلۡأَمۡرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ثُمَّ يَعۡرُجُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمٖ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥٓ أَلۡفَ سَنَةٖ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
verses.indopak: يُدَبِّرُ الْاَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ اِلَيْهِ فِىْ يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهٗۤ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوْنَ
verses.transliteration: yudabbiru alamra mina alssamai ila alardi thumma ya'ruju ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu alfa sanatin mimma ta'uddoona
verses.saheeh: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.
verses.khattab: He conducts every affair from the heavens to the earth, then it all ascends to Him on a Day whose length is a thousand years by your counting
verses.jalalayn: ﻿He directs the command from the heaven to the earth, for the duration of this world, then it ascends, then the command and the direction [thereof] returns, to Him in a day whose measure is a thousand years by your reckoning, in this world. In sūrat sa’ala, [An asker] asked [the measure is said to be]: ‘fifty thousand years’ [Q. 70:4] — and this [day] is the Day of Resurrection, [reckoned so] because of the severity of its terrors for the disbeliever. As for the believer, however, for him it will be easier than performing any one of [his] obligatory prayers in this world — as is stated in hadīth.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh aasmaan se zameen tak duniya ke maamlaat ki tadbeer (planning) karta hai aur is tadbeer ki rudad (record) upar uske huzur jaati hai ek aisey din mein jiski miqdaar tumhare shumar se ek hazar saal hai

verses.uthmani: ذَٰلِكَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.indopak: ذٰلِكَ عٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ ۙ
verses.transliteration: thalika 'alimu alghaybi waalshshahadati al'azeezu alrraheemu
verses.saheeh: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.khattab: That is the Knower of the seen and unseen—the Almighty, Most Merciful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿That, Creator and Director, is the Knower of the Unseen and the visible, that is, what is hidden from creatures and what is present before them, the Mighty, the Invincible in His kingdom, the Merciful, to those who are obedient to Him,
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi hai har posheeda (chupi hui) aur zaahir ka janne wala. Zabardast, aur raheem

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِيٓ أَحۡسَنَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلۡقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنِ مِن طِينٖ
verses.indopak: الَّذِىْۤ اَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهٗ وَبَدَاَ خَلْقَ الْاِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِيْنٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: allathee ahsana kulla shayin khalaqahu wabadaa khalqa alinsani min teenin
verses.saheeh: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.
verses.khattab: Who has perfected everything He created. And He originated the creation of humankind from clay
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Who perfected everything that He created (read khalaqahu, as a past tense functioning as an adjectival qualification [of what He perfected]; or khalqahu, ‘its creation’, as an inclusive substitution [for kulla shay’in, ‘everything’]). And He began the creation of man, Adam, from clay,
verses.romanUrdu: Jo cheez bhi usney banayi khoob hi (acchi tarah) banayi. Usne Insaan ki takhleeq ki ibtida gaarey (mitti /clay) se ki

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسۡلَهُۥ مِن سُلَٰلَةٖ مِّن مَّآءٖ مَّهِينٖ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهٗ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ مَّاۤءٍ مَّهِيْنٍ ۚ
verses.transliteration: thumma ja'ala naslahu min sulalatin min main maheenin
verses.saheeh: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.
verses.khattab: Then He made his descendants from an extract of a humble fluid
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then He made his progeny, his offspring, from an extract, a blood clot, of a base, delicate, fluid, namely, the sperm-drop;
verses.romanUrdu: Phir uski nasal ek aisi saat se chalayi jo hakeer pani (fluid despised) ki tarah ka hai

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ سَوّٰٮهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِهٖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْـــِٕدَةَ ۗ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: thumma sawwahu wanafakha feehi min roohihi waja'ala lakumu alssam'a waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona
verses.saheeh: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
verses.khattab: then He fashioned them and had a spirit of His Own ˹creation˺ breathed into them. And He gave you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks
verses.jalalayn: ﻿then He proportioned him, that is to say, He created Adam, and breathed into him of His spirit, in other words, He made him a living sensory being after having been an inanimate thing. And He made for you, in other words, for [you] his descendants, hearing, meaning, ears, and sight and hearts. Little thanks do you give (mā here is extra, emphasising the ‘littleness’ [of the thanks]).
verses.romanUrdu: Phir usko nik-suk se durust kiya aur uske andar apni rooh phoonk di. Aur tumko kaan diye, aankhein di aur dil diye. Tum log kam hi shukar guazar hotey ho

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا ضَلَلۡنَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِي خَلۡقٖ جَدِيدِۭ ۚ بَلۡ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوْۤا ءَاِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى الْاَرْضِ ءَاِنَّا لَفِىْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيْدٍ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَاۤءِ رَبِّهِمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo aitha dalalna fee alardi ainna lafee khalqin jadeedin bal hum biliqai rabbihim kafiroona
verses.saheeh: And they say, "When we are lost within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.
verses.khattab: ˹Still˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “When we are disintegrated into the earth, will we really be raised as a new creation?” In fact, they are in denial of the meeting with their Lord
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they, namely, the deniers of resurrection, say, ‘When we are lost beneath the earth, [when] we have gone thereunder, having become dust mixed with its dust, shall we be indeed created anew?’ (an interrogative of denial; [read a-innā] by pronouncing both hamzas, or by not pronouncing the second one and inserting an alif between them either way, in both places). God, exalted be He, says: Nay, but they disbelieve in the encounter with their Lord, through resurrection.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur yeh log kehte hain: “jab hum mitti mein ral-mil chuke honge to kya hum phir naye sirey se paida kiye jayenge?” Asal baat yeh hai ke yeh apne Rubb ki mulaqaat ke munkir hain

verses.uthmani: ۞ قُلۡ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ ٱلَّذِي وُكِّلَ بِكُمۡ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ
verses.indopak: ۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفّٰٮكُمْ مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِىْ وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُوْنَ٪
verses.transliteration: qul yatawaffakum malaku almawti allathee wukkila bikum thumma ila rabbikum turja'oona
verses.saheeh: Say, "The angel of death will take you who has been entrusted with you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Your soul will be taken by the Angel of Death, who is in charge of you. Then to your Lord you will ˹all˺ be returned.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say, to them: ‘The Angel of death, who has been charged with you, shall receive you [in death], in other words, he shall seize your spirits, then to your Lord you shall be returned’, alive, whereat He will requite you for your deeds.
verses.romanUrdu: Insey kaho “Maut ka woh farishta jo tumpar muqarrar kiya gaya hai tumko poora ka poora apne qabze mein le lega aur phir tum apne Rubb ki taraf palta laye jaoge”

verses.uthmani: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ نَاكِسُواْ رُءُوسِهِمۡ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ رَبَّنَآ أَبۡصَرۡنَا وَسَمِعۡنَا فَٱرۡجِعۡنَا نَعۡمَلۡ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَوْ تَرٰۤى اِذِ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ نَاكِسُوْا رُءُوْسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ رَبَّنَاۤ اَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًـا اِنَّا مُوْقِنُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: walaw tara ithi almujrimoona nakisoo ruoosihim 'inda rabbihim rabbana absarna wasami'na faarji'na na'mal salihan inna mooqinoona
verses.saheeh: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."
verses.khattab: If only you could see the wicked hanging their heads ˹in shame˺ before their Lord, ˹crying:˺ “Our Lord! We have now seen and heard, so send us back and we will do good. We truly have sure faith ˹now˺!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And if could you but see the guilty, the disbelievers, hanging their heads [low] before their Lord, lowering them in shame, saying: ‘Our Lord! We have seen, the resurrection that we denied, and heard, from You the confirmation of [the truth of] the messengers concerning that in which we used to call them liars. So send us back, to the world, so that we may act righteously, therein, for indeed we are convinced’, now. But none of this is of any use to them and they will not be sent back (the response to [the conditional clause beginning with] law, ‘if’, is [an implicit] ‘you would see a terrible thing’).
verses.romanUrdu: Kaash tum dekho woh waqt jab yeh mujrim sar jhukaye apne Rubb ke huzur khade hongey. (Us waqt yeh keh rahe hongey) “ Aey hamare Rubb, humne khoob dekh liya aur sun liya , ab humein wapas bhej de taa-ke hum neik amal karein. Humein ab yaqeen aa gaya hai.”

verses.uthmani: وَلَوۡ شِئۡنَا لَأٓتَيۡنَا كُلَّ نَفۡسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَٰكِنۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ مِنِّي لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ
verses.indopak: وَ لَوْ شِئْنَا لَاٰتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدٰٮهَا وَلٰـكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّىْ لَاَمْلَئَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: walaw shina laatayna kulla nafsin hudaha walakin haqqa alqawlu minnee laamlaanna jahannama mina aljinnati waalnnasi ajma'eena
verses.saheeh: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.
verses.khattab: Had We willed, We could have easily imposed guidance on every soul. But My Word will come to pass: I will surely fill up Hell with jinn and humans all together
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God, exalted be He, says: ‘And had We [so] willed, We could have given every soul its [means to] guidance, so that it may be guided through faith and obedience, through its own choice, but My Word became due, and it is that: “Verily I shall fill Hell with jinn and mankind together”.
verses.romanUrdu: (Jawab mein irshad hoga) “Agar hum chahte to pehle hi har nafs ko iski hidayat de detay, magar meri woh baat poori ho gayi jo maine kahi thi ke main jahannum ko Jinno aur Insano sab se bhar dunga

verses.uthmani: فَذُوقُواْ بِمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمۡ ۖ وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخُلۡدِ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: فَذُوْقُوْا بِمَا نَسِيْتُمْ لِقَاۤءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا ۚ اِنَّا نَسِيْنٰكُمْ وَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: fathooqoo bima naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha inna naseenakum wathooqoo 'athaba alkhuldi bima kuntum ta'maloona
verses.saheeh: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."
verses.khattab: So taste ˹the punishment˺ for neglecting the meeting of this Day of yours. We ˹too˺ will certainly neglect you. And taste the torment of eternity for what you used to do
verses.jalalayn: ﻿When they enter [Hell] its Keepers shall say to them: So taste [now], the chastisement, for your having forgotten the encounter of this day of yours, in other words, for your having neglected to believe in it. We [too] shall forget you, we shall abandon you in the chastisement. And taste [now] the everlasting chastisement for what you used to practise’, of disbelief and denial.
verses.romanUrdu: Pas ab chakkho maza apni is harakat ka ke tumne is din ki mulaqat ko faramosh kardiya. Humne bhi ab tumhein faramosh kardiya hai. Chakkho hameshgi ke azaab ka maza apne kartooton ki padash mein”

verses.uthmani: إِنَّمَا يُؤۡمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهَا خَرُّواْ سُجَّدٗا وَسَبَّحُواْ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ ۩
verses.indopak: اِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا الَّذِيْنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِهَا خَرُّوْا سُجَّدًا وَّسَبَّحُوْا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ ۩
verses.transliteration: innama yuminu biayatina allatheena itha thukkiroo biha kharroo sujjadan wasabbahoo bihamdi rabbihim wahum la yastakbiroona
verses.saheeh: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allah] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.
verses.khattab: The only ˹true˺ believers in Our revelation are those who—when it is recited to them—fall into prostration and glorify the praises of their Lord and are not too proud
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Only those believe in Our signs, [such as] the Qur'an, who, when they are reminded of them, admonished [with them], fall down in prostration and make glorifications, ensconced, in praise of their Lord, in other words, they say, ‘Glory be to God through His praise’ (subhāna’Llāh wa-bi-hāmdihi), and they do not disdain, to believe and to obey.
verses.romanUrdu: Hamari aayat par to woh log iman laatey hain jinhein yeh aayat suna kar jab naseehat ki jaati hai to sajde mein gir padte hain aur apne Rubb ki hamd ke saath uski tasbeeh karte hain aur takabbur nahin karte

verses.uthmani: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمَضَاجِعِ يَدۡعُونَ رَبَّهُمۡ خَوۡفٗا وَطَمَعٗا وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنَٰهُمۡ يُنفِقُونَ
verses.indopak: تَتَجَافٰى جُنُوْبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَّطَمَعًا ۖ وَّمِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: tatajafa junoobuhum 'ani almadaji'i yad'oona rabbahum khawfan watama'an wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona
verses.saheeh: They arise from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
verses.khattab: They abandon their beds, invoking their Lord with hope and fear, and donate from what We have provided for them
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Their sides withdraw, they rise, from their lying places, the places for lying down [to sleep] together with the bedding, in order to spend the night in prayer (tahajjud), to supplicate to their Lord in fear, of His punishment, and in hope, of His mercy, and they expend of what We have provided them, they give voluntary alms.
verses.romanUrdu: Unki peethein (backs) bistaron se alag rehti hain, apne Rubb ko khauf aur tamaa (umeed) ke saath pukarte hain. Aur jo kuch rizq humne unhein diya hai usmein se kharch karte hain

verses.uthmani: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أُخۡفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعۡيُنٖ جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّاۤ اُخْفِىَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ قُرَّةِ اَعْيُنٍ ۚ جَزَاۤءً بِۢمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: fala ta'lamu nafsun ma okhfiya lahum min qurrati a'yunin jazaan bima kanoo ya'maloona
verses.saheeh: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes as reward for what they used to do.
verses.khattab: No soul can imagine what delights are kept in store for them as a reward for what they used to do
verses.jalalayn: ﻿For no soul knows what has been kept hidden for them in the way of joyous sights (a variant reading [for ukhfiya] has the imperfect tense ukhfī) as a reward for what they used to do.
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jaisa kuch aankhon ki thandak ka saamaan unke aamaal ki jaza mein unke liye chupa kar rakkha gaya hai uski kisi mutanaffis (person/soul) ko khabar nahin hai

verses.uthmani: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤۡمِنٗا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقٗا ۚ لَّا يَسۡتَوُۥنَ
verses.indopak: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۗ لَا يَسْتَوٗنَ
verses.transliteration: afaman kana muminan kaman kana fasiqan la yastawoona
verses.saheeh: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.
verses.khattab: Is the one who is a believer equal ˹before Allah˺ to the one who is rebellious? They are not equal
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Is he who is a believer like him who is a transgressor? They are not equal, namely, the believers and the transgressors.
verses.romanUrdu: Bhala kahin yeh ho sakta hai ke jo shaks momin ho woh us shaks ki tarah ho jaye jo faasiq (nafarman/evil doer) ho? Yeh dono barabar nahin ho saktey

verses.uthmani: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰ نُزُلَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنّٰتُ الْمَأْوٰى ۖ نُزُلًا بِۢمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: amma allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo alssalihati falahum jannatu almawa nuzulan bima kanoo ya'maloona
verses.saheeh: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.
verses.khattab: As for those who believe and do good, they will have the Gardens of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—as an accommodation for what they used to do
verses.jalalayn: ﻿As for those who believe and perform righteous deeds, for them shall be the Gardens of the Abode — a hospitality (nuzul is what is prepared for a guest) for what they used to do.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo log iman laye hain aur jinhon ne neik amal kiye hain unke liye to jannaton ki qayam-gahein (hospitable homes) hain. Ziyafat ke taur par unke aamal ke badle mein

verses.uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُواْ فَمَأۡوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓاْ أَن يَخۡرُجُواْ مِنۡهَآ أُعِيدُواْ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمۡ ذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ فَسَقُوْا فَمَأْوٰٮهُمُ النَّارُكُلَّمَاۤ اَرَادُوْۤا اَنْ يَّخْرُجُوْا مِنْهَاۤ اُعِيْدُوْا فِيْهَا وَ قِيْلَ لَهُمْ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِىْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waamma allatheena fasaqoo famawahumu alnnaru kullama aradoo an yakhrujoo minha o'eedoo feeha waqeela lahum thooqoo 'athaba alnnari allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
verses.saheeh: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."
verses.khattab: But as for those who are rebellious, the Fire will be their home. Whenever they try to escape from it, they will be forced back into it, and will be told, “Taste the Fire’s torment, which you used to deny.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But as for those who transgressed, by disbelieving and denying, their abode shall be the Fire. Whenever they seek to exit from it, they shall be brought back into it, and it shall be said to them, ‘Taste the chastisement of the Fire which you used to deny’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jinhon ne fisq (na-farmani) ikhtiyar kiya hai unka thikana dozakh hai.Jab kabhi woh ussey nikalna chahenge usi mein dhakail diye jayenge aur unsey kaha jayega ke chakkho ab usi aag ke azaab ka maza jisko tum jhutlaya karte thay

verses.uthmani: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَدۡنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡأَكۡبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلَنُذِيْقَنَّهُمْ مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَدْنٰى دُوْنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: walanutheeqannahum mina al'athabi aladna doona al'athabi alakbari la'allahum yarji'oona
verses.saheeh: And we will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will repent.
verses.khattab: We will certainly make them taste some of the minor torment ˹in this life˺ before the major torment ˹of the Hereafter˺, so perhaps they will return ˹to the Right Path˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We shall surely make them taste the nearer chastisement, that is, the chastisement of this world — in their being killed or taken captive, or [through] years of drought and disease — before the greater chastisement, the chastisement of the Hereafter, that perhaps they, namely, those remaining of them, may return, to belief.

wbw.translation: And surely, We will let them taste

verses.romanUrdu: Us baday azaab se pehle hum isi duniya mein (kisi na kisi chote) azaab ka maza inhein chakhate rahenge. Shayad ke yeh (apne baagiyana [transgression] rawish se) baaz aa jayein

verses.uthmani: وَمَنۡ أَظۡلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهَآ ۚ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ ثُمَّ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهَا ۗ اِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ٪
verses.transliteration: waman athlamu mimman thukkira biayati rabbihi thumma a'rada 'anha inna mina almujrimeena muntaqimoona
verses.saheeh: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.
verses.khattab: And who does more wrong than the one who is reminded of Allah’s revelations then turns away from them? We will surely inflict punishment upon the wicked
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And who does greater wrong than he who is reminded of the signs of his Lord, [such as] the Qur'an, but then turns away from them?, in other words, none does greater wrong than such [a person]. Assuredly We shall take vengeance upon the criminals, the idolaters.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur ussey bada zaalim kaun hoga jisey uske Rubb ki aayat ke zariye se naseehat ki jaye aur phir woh inse mooh pher ley.Aisey mujreemo se to hum inteqam lekar rahenge

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِي مِرۡيَةٖ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ هُدٗى لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِىْ مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْ لِّقَاۤٮِٕهٖ وَجَعَلْنٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىْۤ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba fala takun fee miryatin min liqaihi waja'alnahu hudan libanee israeela
verses.saheeh: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And we made the Torah guidance for the Children of Israel.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We gave the Scripture to Moses—so let there be no doubt ˹O Prophet˺ that you ˹too˺ are receiving revelations—and We made it a guide for the Children of Israel
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We gave Moses the Scripture, the Torah; so do not be in doubt concerning the encounter with Him, and indeed he and He met on the Night of the Journey; and We appointed him, namely, Moses — or [read ‘We appointed it’] the Scripture, a guidance for the Children of Israel.
verses.romanUrdu: Issey pehle hum Moosa ko kitaab de chuke hain. Lihaza usi cheez ke milne par tumhein koi shakk na hona chahiye. Us kitab ko humne bani Israel ke liye hidayat banaya tha

verses.uthmani: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ أَئِمَّةٗ يَهۡدُونَ بِأَمۡرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُواْ ۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.indopak: وَ جَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ اَٮِٕمَّةً يَّهْدُوْنَ بِاَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوْا ۗ وَكَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يُوْقِنُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waja'alna minhum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina lamma sabaroo wakanoo biayatina yooqinoona
verses.saheeh: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.
verses.khattab: We raised from among them leaders, guiding by Our command, when they patiently endured and firmly believed in Our signs
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We appointed among them leaders (read a-immatan by pronouncing both hamzas, or by substituting the second one with a yā) who guided, people, by Our command, when they had endured [patiently], in [observing] their religion, and against the hardships [they suffered] because of their enemies (lammā, ‘when’: a variant reading has limā, ‘because’) and had conviction in Our signs, [the ones] indicating Our power and Our Oneness.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab unhon ne sabr kiya aur hamari aayaat par yaqeen latey rahey to unke andar humne aise peshwa paida kiye jo hamare hukum se rehnumayi (hidayat/guidance) karte thay

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفۡصِلُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فِيْمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: inna rabbaka huwa yafsilu baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona
verses.saheeh: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
verses.khattab: Indeed, your Lord will decide between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ, in matters of religion.
verses.romanUrdu: Yaqeenan tera Rubb hi qayamat ke roz un baaton ka faisla karega jinmein (bani Israel) baaham(aapas mein) ikhtilaf karte rahey hain

verses.uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَهۡدِ لَهُمۡ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ يَمۡشُونَ فِي مَسَٰكِنِهِمۡ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٍ ۚ أَفَلَا يَسۡمَعُونَ
verses.indopak: اَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ يَمْشُوْنَ فِىْ مَسٰكِنِهِمْ ۗ اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ ۗ اَفَلَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna min qablihim mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin afala yasma'oona
verses.saheeh: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?
verses.khattab: Is it not yet clear to them how many peoples We destroyed before them, whose ruins they still pass by? Surely in this are signs. Will they not then listen
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or is it not an indication for them how many generations, communities, on account of their disbelief, We destroyed before them, that is to say, has [not] Our destruction of many [generations] become clear to the disbelievers of Mecca, amid whose dwellings they walk (yamshūna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the person of the pronoun lahum, ‘for them’) during their travels to Syria and other places, so that they might take heed? Surely in that there are signs, indications of Our power. Are they not able to hear?, in a way so as to reflect and be admonished.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kya in logon ko (in tareekhi (historical) waqiyat mein) koi hidayat nahin mili ke unse pehle kitni qaumon ko hum halaak kar chuke hain jinke rehne ki jaghon mein aaj yeh chalte phirte hain? Ismein badi nishaniyan hain. Kya yeh sunte nahin hain

verses.uthmani: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلۡمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ ٱلۡجُرُزِ فَنُخۡرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرۡعٗا تَأۡكُلُ مِنۡهُ أَنۡعَٰمُهُمۡ وَأَنفُسُهُمۡ ۚ أَفَلَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
verses.indopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّا نَسُوْقُ الْمَاۤءَ اِلَى الْاَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهٖ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ اَنْعَامُهُمْ وَاَنْفُسُهُمْ ۗ اَفَلَا يُبْصِرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: awalam yaraw anna nasooqu almaa ila alardi aljuruzi fanukhriju bihi zar'an takulu minhu an'amuhum waanfusuhum afala yubsiroona
verses.saheeh: Have they not seen that We drive the water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?
verses.khattab: Do they not see how We drive rain to parched land, producing ˹various˺ crops from which they and their cattle eat? Will they not then see
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or have they not seen how We drive the water to barren land (juruz), [this] is arid land that contains no vegetation), and therewith bring forth crops whereof their cattle and [they] themselves eat? Can they not see?, this and so realise that We have the power to bring them back [to life after death].
verses.romanUrdu: Aur kya in logon ne yeh manzar kabhi nahin dekha ke hum ek bay-aab o gayah (banjar) zameen ki taraf pani baha latey hain, aur phir usi zameen se woh fasal ugati hai jissey unke jaanwaron ko bhi chara milta hai aur yeh khud bhi khate hain? To kya inhein kuch nahin soojhta

verses.uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡفَتۡحُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْفَتْحُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: wayaqooloona mata hatha alfathu in kuntum sadiqeena
verses.saheeh: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"
verses.khattab: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this ˹Day of final˺ Decision, if what you say is true?”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they say, to the believers: ‘When will this [decisive] Judgement, between us and yourselves, be, if you are truthful?’
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log kehte hain ke “yeh faisla kab hoga agar tum sachhey ho?”

verses.uthmani: قُلۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَتۡحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِيمَٰنُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.indopak: قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا اِيْمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qul yawma alfathi la yanfa'u allatheena kafaroo eemanuhum wala hum yuntharoona
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “On the Day of Decision it will not benefit the disbelievers to believe then, nor will they be delayed ˹from punishment˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘On the day of [this] Judgement, [which will be effected] by sending the chastisement on them, their [newly found] faith [then] shall not benefit those who had been disbelievers, nor shall they be given respite, to make repentance or [offer] excuses.
verses.romanUrdu: Insey kaho “faisle ke din iman laana un logon ke liye kuch bhi nafeh (faidemand) na hoga jinhon ne kufr kiya hai aur phir unko koi mohlat na milegi.”

verses.uthmani: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَٱنتَظِرۡ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ
verses.indopak: فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانْتَظِرْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّنْتَظِرُوْنَ٪
verses.transliteration: faa'rid 'anhum waintathir innahum muntathiroona
verses.saheeh: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
verses.khattab: So turn away from them, and wait! They too are waiting
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So turn away from them, and wait, for the chastisement to be sent down on them. They too are waiting, for your death to take place or [for you] to be killed and so be rid of you — this was [revealed] before the command to fight them.
verses.romanUrdu: Accha, inhein inke haal par chodh do aur intezar karo, yeh bhi muntazir (intezar kar rahe) hain
